facts.text: The user wants to talk about skills intelligence platforms.
The user asked how employees can demonstrate that they have certain skills and have those skills recorded on skills intelligence platforms.
The user asked what the most typical approaches are for skills proficiency validation or verification.
The user asked for best practices for employers to define the skills for a particular role.
The user asked for best practices that guarantee success on the role.
The user asked whether using a skills intelligence platform is worth the effort.
The user asked what the expected and typical outcomes are for companies that successfully implement skills intelligence platforms.
The user asked for help building a 3-slide deck to pitch the use of a skills intelligence platform to management.
The user said management will be interested in the effort required in resources and time and the benefits the company can get.
The user asked for a five-slide deck instead of three slides.
The user asked to include key enablers for successful implementation in the five-slide deck.
The user asked to include the company’s current status in the five-slide deck.
